commit.message:
chore: bump mathlib to 56a0058 (v4.35.0), fix breaking changes (#1205)

Bumps mathlib from 1f41440 to 56a0058 -- the v4.35.0 tag, 168 commits
on, and the toolchain from v4.35.0-rc4 to v4.35.0 to match.

* mathlib#44568 (`chore: use extends for EquivClasses`) made
`MulEquivClass`, `AddEquivClass`
and `RingEquivClass` extend the corresponding hom classes, so the class
field
`MulEquivClass.map_mul` no longer exists. We update FLT accordingly; the
simp lemma `map_mul`
  now applies directly, so the explicit simp argument is simply dropped.
* mathlib#44279 (`feat: ValuativeRel and IsValuativeTopology
(v.adicCompletion K)`) renamed
`adicCompletion.valued_toCompletion` and
`adicCompletion.valued_ofCompletion` to
`valued_toCompletion_apply` and `valued_ofCompletion_apply` (they are no
longer `rfl`),
  deprecating the old names. We update FLT accordingly.
* mathlib#40901 (`feat: zero-dimensional spaces`) restated the
clopen-basis results for
`ZeroDimensionalSpace`, deprecating `compact_exists_isClopen_in_isOpen`
in favour of
  `exists_isClopen_mem_of_isOpen`, and deprecating the modules
`Mathlib.Topology.Separation.Profinite` and
`Mathlib.Topology.Separation.Lemmas`. We update
FLT's lemma name and imports accordingly, using the replacement imports
the deprecations name.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
